why: The learner moved each row into a TodoItem component (src/TodoItem.jsx) and put key={todo.id} on the <li> inside it, but the element map returns in TodoList.jsx is <TodoItem todo={todo} />, with no key. React reads keys only on the elements in the mapped array, so it warns 'Each child in a list should have a unique "key" prop' (check the render method of TodoList). The key has to go on <TodoItem key={todo.id} ... />.

step.title: Render the to-dos with map
step.instructions: In src/TodoList.jsx, render the todos array with todos.map, one <li> per to-do. Give each item a unique key (key={todo.id}) and strike through the done ones with style={{ textDecoration: todo.done ? 'line-through' : 'none' }}.
hints: The key goes on the outermost element map returns.
common_mistakes: Leaving the key off, or giving every item the same key.
